animations.name: marquee
animations.description: Continuous horizontal scroll animation for the partner logo strip, running at 30s linear infinite.

animations.name: fadeIn
animations.css: @keyframes fadeIn { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px) } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) } }
animations.description: Fade in with upward slide animation for elements appearing on the page.

animations.name: fill-width
animations.description: Progress bar fill animation expanding from 0 to 100% width.

animations.name: se-float
animations.css: @keyframes se-float { 0%, to { transform: translateY(0) } 50% { transform: translateY(-10px) } }
animations.description: Floating animation with subtle vertical movement for decorative elements.

animations.name: ping
animations.description: Ping/pulse animation for attention indicators, scaling up and fading out.

animations.name: pulse
animations.description: Subtle opacity pulse animation for loading or attention states.

animations.name: enter
animations.css: @keyframes enter { 0% { opacity: var(--tw-enter-opacity, 1); transform: translate3d(var(--tw-enter-translate-x, 0), var(--tw-enter-translate-y, 0), 0) scale3d(var(--tw-enter-scale, 1), var(--tw-enter-scale, 1), var(--tw-enter-scale, 1)) rotate(var(--tw-enter-rotate, 0)) } }
animations.description: Tailwind CSS animate-in keyframes for customizable enter animations with opacity, translate, scale, and rotate.

animations.name: exit
animations.css: @keyframes exit { to { opacity: var(--tw-exit-opacity, 1); transform: translate3d(var(--tw-exit-translate-x, 0), var(--tw-exit-translate-y, 0), 0) scale3d(var(--tw-exit-scale, 1), var(--tw-exit-scale, 1), var(--tw-exit-scale, 1)) rotate(var(--tw-exit-rotate, 0)) } }
animations.description: Tailwind CSS exit keyframes for customizable exit animations.

animations.name: global-transition
animations.css: transition: color, background-color, border-color, text-decoration-color, fill, stroke, opacity, box-shadow, transform, filter, backdrop-filter 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)
animations.description: Default Tailwind transition applied to interactive elements for smooth state changes.

animations.name: accordion-height-transition
animations.description: Smooth height transition for accordion expand/collapse using grid-template-rows animation.

animations.name: hover-scale
animations.description: Hover scale effect on product feature card images, scaling to 110% on hover.

animations.name: scroll-reveal
animations.description: JS-driven scroll reveal animation using GSAP or similar. Elements fade in and translate from (0, 60px) or (0, 40px) to their final position as they enter the viewport.

insights: The design system uses a sophisticated color-coded button hierarchy: orange (#FF6106) for primary CTAs, green (#15502E) for in-context actions, and ghost/outline variants for secondary actions, maintaining clear visual hierarchy across light and dark sections.
Accordion and tab components employ a smooth grid-template-rows animation pattern for height changes, providing buttery expand/collapse transitions without fixed heights.
The marquee logo strip with hover-pause functionality and continuous 30s animation creates ambient movement without being distracting, a common pattern for social proof sections.
